verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay's own docs say you can self-host a private CDN and deploy moq-relay anywhere, so you decide where relay infrastructure, and the data flowing through it, physically lives. There are no documented region or residency controls, the managed edge explicitly has "no regions to pick," and the relay is a pass-through, so storage location is not addressed. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection settings, documentation of where data is stored or cached, residency guarantees for the hosted/public relay, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can optionally self-host a private CDN or end-to-end encrypt your content.
